package p

import "testing"

func TestScopes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, t := range []int{1} {
		_ = t
	}
	t.Error("after range")
	t, ok := t, true
	_ = ok
	t.Error("reassigned")
	switch t := any(t).(type) {
	case *testing.T:
		t.Error("type switch")
	}
	func() {
		t := 3
		_ = t
	}()
	t.Fatal("after literal")
}
